Toy’s Dream 🦸‍♂️🧩
Toy’s Dream is a cute and wholesome puzzle-platformer. You are a Hero, who sets out on a journey to save the town that has been attacked by the Demon Lord. He must overcome many obstacles along the way, using glue and thread...

Dad : So I have to role-play as the Hero?
Son : Yes! I’ve prepared a lot of obstacles for you! Hehe... I hope you’ll be able to save the town, Hero...

That’s right! Toy’s Dream is a story of a father and son playing with toys together!

Use glue and thread 🧵
Use glue and thread to overcome obstacles. Glue can slow movement down. Thread can be used to swing back and forth. You’ll have to figure out how to overcome obstacles using these two tools.

Craft items 🛠️
Along the way, there’ll be piles of scraps. With glue and thread in your hands, you can use these scraps to craft items that will be useful in your journey.

Face various types of monsters 👾
The Demon Lord’s minions are ready to harass you all the time. You’ll have to escape from these monsters in any way you can.

Features ✨

  • Various patterns of platforms and puzzles: Use items that you have. Find a way to overcome obstacles.

  • Storybook-like visual: A world full of toys. Warm color tone. Cute art style.

  • Gives you a warm and nostalgic feeling: Cute conversations between a father and child playing together. Sometimes teasing. Sometimes praising.
